name: The Last Maul
summary: The Last Maul is a cooperative maze tower defense game played in a web browser by one to eight players. Creeps cross open ground toward a town, and the towers players build act as walls that lengthen the creeps' path without ever blocking it completely. Each player builds in a separate lane, and the team shares a single pool of lives. Players choose one of eight races, each with its own tower lines that branch into specializations at the second tier. A run lasts 120 waves split into four acts, with giant bosses at the end of the later acts. A daily challenge gives every player the same race, map and starting conditions, and empty seats can be filled by computer-controlled teammates.
